en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Dyad on the Fine-Material Sphere (Rūpāvacaraduka).
Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive fine-material-sphere state, there arises a non-manifesting, non-reactive non-fine-material-sphere state by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six under root; six under predominance … pe … three under object … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and not belonging to the fine-material sphere, there arises a dhamma that is neither demonstrable nor reacting and not belonging to the fine-material sphere, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
